raw_text: Renewed fighting between Myanmar's military and the Arakan Army has triggered fresh displacement of Rohingya civilians toward Bangladesh. The Bangladesh Border Guard fired warning shots as hundreds attempted to cross near Teknaf in Cox's Bazar district. India's intelligence agencies are monitoring the situation for potential secondary migration flows through the Chittagong Hill Tracts into Tripura and Mizoram. The Ministry of Home Affairs has directed BSF units along the northeast border to maintain heightened vigilance.
clean_text: Myanmar-Arakan Army fighting displacing Rohingya toward Bangladesh. BGB fires warning shots at Teknaf. India's MHA directs BSF to heighten vigilance on northeast border.
